title: Human acceptance recipe — one run
description: What the page writes: one document per run, never modified afterwards. A second pass is a second document. States use the evidence vocabulary of the framework: passed, failed, blocked (unavailable to the tester), skipped (optional step), null (unanswered).

specSha256.description: Fingerprint of the spec the page was built from. Says WHICH revision the tester answered: if the spec was amended since, the run is stale and the affected steps are replayed.

observedVersion.description: Version the tester actually saw on screen.

carriedFrom.description: Present when the page continued a run that answered another revision of the recipe. The rule is fixed: an answer travelled only when its line was identical (same step, same letter, same text); every other line was asked again. The earlier run is left untouched.

runId.description: The run the answers came from.

specSha256.description: The revision that run answered; null when it carried no fingerprint.

toAnswer.description: Lines of this revision left unanswered by the carry.

steps.description: Key = step id from the spec.

note.description: Free remark for the whole step.

text.description: Snapshot of the expectation as the tester read it.

note.description: What the tester saw instead, word for word — the most useful material there is.
